derivation_rules.UNVERIFIABLE: dependency_present=true AND dependency_revoked=false AND dependency_dispute_open=false AND verification_succeeds=false
derivation_rules.STALE: dependency_present=true AND verification_succeeds=true AND intrinsic_valid=true AND freshness_valid=false
derivation_rules.BINDING_MISMATCH: dependency_present=true AND verification_succeeds=true AND intrinsic_valid=true AND freshness_valid=true AND binding_matches=false
derivation_rules.VERSION_OR_EPOCH_MISMATCH: dependency_present=true AND verification_succeeds=true AND intrinsic_valid=true AND freshness_valid=true AND binding_matches=true AND (version_matches=false OR epoch_matches=false)
derivation_rules.VALID: all required dependency validity facts held
